summary: Dialogflow CX can export flows as diagrams in draw.io XML format.
extended_definition: Dialogflow CX can export flows as diagrams in draw.io XML format.

supporting_pages.title: Flows \_|\_ Dialogflow CX \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: The export format is draw.io XML, so you can import the diagram in Lucidchart , diagrams.net , or any other diagram tool that can import the draw.io format.
Diagram export ( Preview ): This exports your flow as a visual diagram.
Note: Diagram export is not available for agents using CMEK .

supporting_pages.title: Flows | Dialogflow CX | Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: O formato de exportação é XML draw.io, pelo que pode importar o diagrama para o Lucidchart , o diagrams.net ou qualquer outra ferramenta de diagramas que possa importar o formato draw.io.

supporting_pages.title: "Interaction logging export to BigQuery \_|\_ Dialogflow CX \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: Use the following SQL statement for creation: CREATE TABLE < your dataset name > . dialogflow bigquery export data ( project id STRING , agent id STRING , conversation name STRING , turn position INTEGER , request time TIMESTAMP , language code STRING , request JSON , response JSON , partial responses JSON , derived data JSON , conversation signals JSON , bot answer feedback JSON ); Configure your agent settings to enable BigQuery export, and to provide the dataset and table names created above.
Service account format: service-<dialogflow-project-number>@gcp-sa-dialogflow.iam.gserviceaccount.com The user configuring the export in Dialogflow must have permissions on the BigQuery project.
